sources.publisher: Prince William County GIS / Planning / Development Services
sources.approval_scope: user-authorized local public-record reads; not unrestricted redistribution
sources.redistribution_policy: review_required; no raw records or credentials in public Git
sources.terms_notes: Metadata attributes county agencies; a blanket downstream document/data license was not established. No publication of raw payloads is authorized.
sources.authority: Prince William County Development Services / Planning
sources.identity: validated layer-qualified GlobalID; OBJECTID only for ordering; change collection_epoch only on genuine identity reset
sources.campus_link: exact nonempty PlanningCaseNumber -> uniquely matching campus CaseNumber; all other relationships unresolved/reviewer-only
sources.date_policy: ArcGIS epoch-ms retained as source timestamp; YearBuilt year-only; OCCDate reported occupancy, not operations; effective dates unknown unless explicitly evidenced
sources.unit_policy: GFA fields retained raw; no canonical area/power/capital claims until unit/basis mappings are reviewed
sources.pagination: stable OBJECTID ordering, bounded pages, duplicate-key checks, count-before/count-after, stop on inconsistent completeness
sources.rate_limit: sequential source queries with 250ms pause; no automatic retry after 401/403
sources.proposed_cadence: daily snapshot; weekly complete reconciliation; not enabled
sources.publication_cadence: county ongoing updates, no daily publication guarantee
sources.historical_coverage: current snapshot only; no past-knowledge reconstruction
sources.document_handling: layers advertise no attachments; raw metadata/pages archived; linked permits are references, not downloaded by this adapter

sources.activation_gate: permitted repeatable inventory/PDF route or approved export; no bypass or assumed bulk access
validate supported bulk/export/portal method and unattended access permission
